title: Velo Purple Grape Mini Nicotine Pouches
description: Velo Mini Purple Grape Nicotine Pouches capture the sweet, juicy taste of Red Grapes complemented by a hint of acidity, for a flavour that tastes fruity and distinctive. Each can contains 15 slim pouches made from plant-based fibres, designed for a discreet and comfortable fit under the lip. Nicotine is released steadily without smoke, vapour or odour, making these pouches a convenient option at any time of day. Produced in Europe, Velo nicotine pouches are available in a wide range of flavours and strengths. Velo Mini cans contain 15 pouches, and Purple Grape is offered in two Mild strengths: 4mg for those who prefer a gentler experience, and 6mg for a slightly more pronounced nicotine level. Nicotine Ranges: Mellow - 4mg to 6mg this is best for new users. Original - 6mg to 11mg this is best for regular users. Intense - 8mg to 17mg this is suited for more experienced users How to Use: Place one pouch under your upper lip and leave it in place for 20–40 minutes while the flavour and nicotine release gradually. When finished, remove the pouch and dispose of it responsibly. Please Note: Do not chew, suck or swallow the pouches.
